{07 00 00}OK, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 14 00}I heard
that you're really good at
fishing. Is that true?
{07 00 00}But...{01 00 00 05 00}are you good enough
to catch a rare fish?{01 00 00 0f 00} Well,
prove it, then!
Let's see who can catch 
the rarest fish first! {01 01 00}{07 0b 00}Well?{01 00 00 05 00}
Shall we, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Olgu, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 14 00}Ma kuulsin,
et sa oled väga hea
kalapüüdja. Kas see on
tõsi? {07 00 00}Aga...{01 00 00 05 00}kas sa oled
piisavalt hea, et püüda
haruldane kala?{01 00 00 0f 00} tõesta siis!
Vaatame, kes püüab
esimesena haruldasema! {01 01 00}{07 0b 00}
Noh?{01 00 00 05 00} Kas teeme, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
So, {04 1f 00}, you must
be pretty good at fishing,
huh, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 19 00}But fishing isn't just about
technique!{01 01 00} {07 15 00}You gotta do
your research, too!
{07 04 00}Hey,{01 00 00 0a 00} let's have a rare fish
match! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 00 00}If you can catch a
rarer fish than I do{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 14 00}Well, I just might have to
concede that you ARE good
at fishing, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Nii et, {04 1f 00}, sa oled
vist päris hea kalapüüdja,
mis, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 19 00}Aga kalapüük pole ainult
tehnika!{01 01 00} {07 15 00}Sa pead ka
uurimistööd tegema!
{07 04 00}Hei,{01 00 00 0a 00} peame haruldase kala
matši! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 00 00}Kui sa suudad püüda
haruldasema kala kui mina{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 14 00}Noh, siis pean vist
tunnistama, et sa OLED hea
kalapüüdja, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}You see,{01 00 00 0a 00} some fish are very
rare, depending on what the
season is.
{07 00 00}For instance, uh{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 01 00} {07 09 00}Uh{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{01 01 00}

{07 00 00}OK! {01 00 00 0a 00}To see who's the better
